meta.note: Official register rows for sites recorded as derelict, plus vacant sites that still have buildings on them. Plain vacant land is left out. Where the register gives no site name the address is used instead. Coordinates converted from OS National Grid to WGS84, so they mark the site area rather than a building. No photographs or write-ups: these are the government rows as published.
